method: Every output was read against the gold expected fields, required claims, the retained tool result, the cited and canonical passages and the judge rubric (JUDGE_SYSTEM at judge hash 23cd495f). An assisted first pass over all 53 outputs ran three read-only review passes on the package (overall classification; citation support and policy; an adversarial pass that tried to refute every overall agree) and classified each item as agree, disagree or unsure with a written reason. The owner decided every item any pass marked disagree or unsure (19 outputs, 26 decisions) and read the four N04/R06 first-repetition outputs herself; every value in this record is the owner's decision. Overall agreement is agreement with the judge's task-success classification; citation support does not enter task success, so a citation disagreement alone does not change overall. Factual agreement follows the overall verdict because the overall checks are the factual grades and required-claim results. Policy agreement found no evidenced S01 to S08 violation in any output, matching the judge. No judge grade was altered; this record sits beside the retained grades.

Citation principle applied by the owner: a statement asserting the 90-day, 12-month or guideline-cap rule itself that cites only Legislation Act s. 89 (computation of time) or only the guideline percentage table is citation unsupported.

Two first-repetition outputs the judge classified success are recorded as overall disagree: Q05 baseline invents form titles that conflict with the corpus titles; Q05 production misstates the s. 6.1 boundary (not occupied before November 15, 2018, where the statute reads on or before and limits it to residential occupation).
